sources.summary: To mark its 30th anniversary, the studio is transforming the public space in front of its headquarters on Avenida Infante Santo into a free exhibition. Thirty large-format panels, designed to resemble giant bookmarks, present 30 projects that have defined the studio's journey back to the city. To celebrate three decades of practice, Saraiva+Associados (S+A) has chosen the public realm as the stage to showcase its history, under the title *REFLEXO. 30 Anos, 30 Projetos* (REFLECTION: 30 Years, 30 Projects).
